Fleet.title: Fleet
Fleet.intro: {units, plural, =0 {No bikes yet} one {# bike} other {# bikes}} in {models, plural, one {# model} other {# models}}.
Fleet.empty: No bikes yet. Add a model, then its bikes, or import them all from a CSV file.

import.title: Import bikes from CSV
import.intro: One row per bike. The whole file is checked first: if any row has a problem, nothing is saved.
import.columnsHelp: “make” and “model” are required. If they match the list below, the bike goes on that entry; where a model has several generations, “model_year” picks the right one. If they don't match, the vehicle becomes one of your own models: give “vehicle_type” (motorbike, car, atv, boat or other; blank means motorbike). A motorbike needs “cc” and “transmission” (automatic, semi_auto or manual); for other vehicles both are optional. “name” is optional: your own name for the model. Leave “plate” blank for a bike without one yet. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD; odometer is in {unit}; purchase price is in {currency}.
import.done: Imported {units, plural, one {# bike} other {# bikes}} and {models, plural, =0 {no new models} one {# new model} other {# new models}}.
import.problems: {count, plural, one {# problem} other {# problems}} found. Nothing was imported.
import.catalogCodes: Makes and models in the list
